Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale General holds 54 vials of ibutilide fumarate 0.1 mg/mL at 4.5 vials per day for 11.9 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 12 vials of ibutilide fumarate 0.1 mg/mL 10 mL vial at 1 vial per day for 12.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's history shows an earlier shortage for ibutilide fumarate first posted on 2022-04-29 and since resolved. The drug is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. The product label names Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189) as the registered plant for manufacture, analysis, API manufacture, labeling, and packing. FDA inspection 1208260 at that plant ended on 2023-06-16 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2024-09-10 — 413 days after the shortage posting on 2022-04-29. The plant has a history of VAI classifications from inspections ending 2009-02-18 through 2023-06-16.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately 12 days of supply at both sites. No active FDA shortage listing exists. The prior shortage has been resolved per FDA records. The manufacturing plant has a long-standing VAI inspection history.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. — requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to verify supply continuity and delivery timeline with Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. — requires buyer approval.
3. Pharmacy director to confirm receipt and allocation plan upon delivery — requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or alternative agent substitutions at this time.
